_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Nang Player {player_id} Three-Player Tic Tac Toe da leiriktre. 
Nang gi symbol '{symbol}' ni. 
Nang na 5x5 board ta nang gi symbol thoknaba hourakpa thouram ama leiri. 
Hourakpa thouram horizontal, vertical, amasung diagonal oina thoknaba yaodre. 
Nang gi thouram '[4]' style da submit touba nang cell 4 bu thoknaba hourakpa.

invalid_move.out_of_range: অবৈধ কোষ সংখ্যা: {cell}। 0 এবং {max_cell} এর মধ্যে হতে হবে।

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} na ama symbol ({symbol}) field ({row}, {col}) da thokhibe.
